Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Law LLB at University of Glasgow

What University of Glasgow asks of applicants to Law LLB for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Glasgow courses · Law field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 5 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma: SAT 1280 or ACT 27, plus two APs at 5 and 5 (or a transcript showing an Honours/Advanced/AP-level course in Year 11 or 12 at A in the mandatory subjects) — Humanities and English required, plus the LNAT
  • SAT/ACT is not required on the AP-only route (three APs at 5, 5, 5) or the high-school transcript route (GPA 3.6 with mandatory subjects at A)
Verified19 Oct 2026Glasgow: Common Law LLB entry requirements for USA applicants (2027 entry) · Glasgow: USA — undergraduate entry requirements
English language
  • IELTS Academic (or Academic Online): 6.5 overall with no subtest under 6.0 (One Skill Retake accepted); one test must meet overall and subtest requirements
  • TOEFL iBT (incl. MyBest, Home Edition): 90 overall for tests up to 20 January 2026 (Reading 20, Listening 19, Speaking 19, Writing 21 minimum); 92 overall for tests from 21 January 2026 (Reading 22, Listening 20, Speaking 23, Writing 21 minimum)
  • PTE Academic:
    • 59 with 59 in all subtests
    • Cambridge C1 Advanced/C2 Proficiency: 176 overall, no subtest below 169
    • Oxford ELLT: 7 overall, no subtest below 6
    • LanguageCert Academic SELT: 70 overall, no subtest below 60
  • Tests must have been taken within 2 years 5 months of the programme start date

Required for applicants from non-English-speaking countries as defined by the UK Government.

Verified19 Oct 2026Glasgow: Common Law LLB (2027 entry)
Admissions tests
  • LNAT — required

Subject prerequisites
  • Required: an A-level Humanities subject at A (Glasgow classes English, History and most arts, social-science and language subjects as Humanities) and GCSE English at B
  • IB: HL English at 6

A Humanities A level at A (Glasgow counts English, History and most arts, social-science and language subjects), GCSE English at B, and for IB HL English at 6 are required; none is expressible in the engine, so no subject is coded.

General Studies

Other qualifications
  • AP-only route: three APs at 5, 5, 5, including Humanities and English subjects, plus the LNAT
  • Required AP courses can be replaced by Advanced, Honors or Dual Credit courses
Verified19 Oct 2026Glasgow: Common Law LLB entry requirements for USA applicants (2027 entry) · Glasgow: USA — undergraduate entry requirements
Other requirements
  • No interview for first-year entry: Glasgow interviews for Community Development, Dentistry, Medicine, Nursing, Teaching and Veterinary Medicine & Surgery
  • Applicants for entry into Year 2 may be interviewed in any subject
  • LNAT is part of the selection process (see Admissions tests)
